title: Actual Test 6 - Listening Test 3
words: outside the box/out of the box

items.vn: (noun). khả năng chuyên môn, chứng chỉ
items.example: We believe that you have all the qualifications for this job, so we want to welcome you to our company.
Because you have graduated, it's time to use that degree to look for a good job.
If you want more general information, please go back to the previous webpage.
Have you considered studying programming in university?
The car salesman showed me the newest models.
There's a new tennis court in the neighborhood.
His favorite subject in engineering school was electronics.
I'm busy right now, but I'll give you a ring later.
You need to do your tasks immediately after you receive them.
He's the most diligent worker in this office.
Let's think of the best way to approach this problem.

items.vn: (adjective). lặp đi lặp lại, theo thói quen
items.example: A large part of my work is routine and repetitive.

items.vn: (verb). hòa hợp, làm việc tốt với ai đó
items.example: She gets along well with her husband's family.
Please help us to assess the quality of our service.
Everyone will inevitably get old.
Human activities have caused great disturbances to the environment.
Steve Jobs demonstrated how the iPhone works.
So why do you want to study more in the field of physics?

items.vn: (adjective). theo mức bình thường, trung bình
items.example: Here you can see the actual measurements of the standard paper sizes.
How can we find the best person for the job from these applicants?
Sometimes you need to take a step back to see the bigger picture.

items.text: outside the box/out of the box
items.vn: (adverb). một cách sáng tạo, độc đáo
items.example: You can tell by looking at Picasso's paintings that he really thought out of the box.
Clean drinking water is provided for people affected by the natural disaster.
Don't be so harsh on your children.
After the initial success of their application, they released it to tablets, cellphones, and smartwatches too.

items.vn: (noun). sự thảo luận, sự bàn bạc
items.example: Before any major surgery, the patient needs to have a consultation with the doctor.
After collecting the data, you need to analyze it.
Joining the army trains young men to have a strong sense of discipline.
Please help us to assess the quality of our service.
If you follow this exercise and diet regime, you'll soon see the results.

We are doing worse and worse with every subsequent week.
It was at the beginning of this year that the forest fires started to occur more frequently.

items.vn: (noun). tổng lượng cơ bắp trong cơ thể
items.example: If you work out frequently and properly, you'll develop more and more muscle mass.
I don't have a lot of stamina so I get tired easily.

I'm feeling extremely energetic today.

items.vn: (noun). người say mê cái gì đó
items.example: Every football enthusiast gathers here to see the final game of the championship.

items.vn: (noun). các phương tiện, công cụ, trang thiết bị
items.example: Some housing facilities were damaged by the storm.
I'm a frequent patron at this restaurant, so I know most of the waiters and waitresses well.
The buffet offers a wide array of food to customers.
I think I have a solid financial footing at the moment.
When you think of trees, your mind will use different examples of trees that you've seen to make a general concept.

items.vn: (noun). thứ hot nhất, hấp dẫn nhất hiện nay
items.example: The show Rap Việt was all the rage; every one I know watches it every week.

items.vn: (adjective). cuối cùng, lớn nhất, quan trọng nhất
items.example: Every small goal that you have should be somehow related to your ultimate goal.
We are looking for a suitable person to fill this position.

items.vn: (noun). sự phân tích, sự phân ra theo thành phần
items.example: This chart shows the breakdown of the US population by age and gender.

items.vn: (adjective). thuộc về nước ngoài, ngoại quốc
items.example: Knowing how to speak a foreign language is a great skill to have.

items.vn: (noun). thạch nhũ có hình dạng giống như đá đang chảy xuống

items.example: It was bigger, but only by a fraction.

sections.title: Section 2: "Fit For Life" Fitness Centre
sections.html:
provide

(verb). cung cấp

Clean drinking water is provided for people affected by the natural disaster.

harsh

Don't be so harsh on your children.

initial

(adjective). đầu tiên

After the initial success of their application, they released it to tablets, cellphones, and smartwatches too.

Before any major surgery, the patient needs to have a consultation with the doctor.

After collecting the data, you need to analyze it.

discipline

(noun). kỷ luật

sections.title: Section 3: Who To Promote?
sections.html:
position

(noun). vị trí, công việc

We are looking for a suitable person to fill this position.

faculty

(noun). khoa

The faculty of medicine only accepts a small number of students each year.

personnel

(noun). nhân sự

The company is conducting a research into its personnel.

dispute

(noun). tranh chấp, tranh cãi

Disputes in the workplace are quite common.

settle

(verb). dàn xếp

He's quite good at settling arguments and disagreements.

reject

(verb). từ chối

There were three applicants in total, and we ended up accepting one and rejecting the other two.

sufficient

(adjective). đầy đủ

He has sufficient skills to do the job by himself.

candidate

(noun). ứng viên

We have a lot of candidates applying for this job.

benefit

(noun). phúc lợi

The benefits of this job seems to be worth more than the actual salary.

petrol

(noun). xăng

We'll need to stop at the petrol station first.

private

(adjective). riêng, riêng tư

I'd like to book a private dining room for ten people, please.

limited

(adjective). hạn chế, ít

You'll have a limited amount of time to finish this project.

narrow down

(verb). thu hẹp lại

The manager has successfully narrowed the list down to these seven people.

breakdown

(noun). sự phân tích, sự phân ra theo thành phần

This chart shows the breakdown of the US population by age and gender.

foreign

(adjective). thuộc về nước ngoài, ngoại quốc

Knowing how to speak a foreign language is a great skill to have.

drawback

(noun). trở ngại, hạn chế

One drawback of social media is that it's extremely time-consuming.

respective

(adjective). tương ứng

Each person has their own respective bag.

feedback

(noun). góp ý, phản hồi

Feedback from customers is always welcome, as it helps us to improve our services.

to excess

(adverb). quá mức

She has a habit of consuming unhealthy food to excess.

express

(noun). bày tỏ

She expresses her disapproval by giving me a thumbs down.

attitude

(noun). thái độ

It's important to keep a good attitude, even when in bad situations.

dean

(noun). trưởng khoa, hiệu trưởng khoa

At the graduation ceremony, the dean of the physics department gives the students their diplomas.

ageism

(noun). phân biệt tuổi tác

He experiences some incidents related to ageism at his new job.

criterion >> criteria (plu- số nhiều)

(noun). tiêu chí

The applicant meets all criteria except for one.

manner

(noun). cách cư xử

Parents should teach their children to have good manners when they are still young.

sections.title: Section 4: Lecture About Caves
sections.html:
ignore

(verb). bỏ qua, lơ đi

You should ignore what people say about you behind your back.

remote

(adjective). xa xôi, hẻo lánh

He lives in such a remote place that there is no internet there.

challenging

(adjective). thách thức, khó khăn

To become successful, you need to learn how to do the challenging tasks, not just the easy ones.

complex

(adjective). phức tạp, khó hiểu

The new problem is so complex that he cannot possibly solve it on his own.

discipline

(noun). môn học

In the discipline of physics, students have to memorize many different formulas.

accurate

(adjective). chính xác

He won the game by having the most accurate throw.

undiscovered

(adjective). chưa được khám phá

There are many animals, especially sea animals, that are currently still undiscovered.

radically

(adverb). một cách to lớn, một cách chóng mặt

Our sales number has been radically increasing since last year.

seep

(verb). thấm vào, rỉ vào

It was raining so hard that water began to seep through our roof.

soluble

(adjective). có thể hòa tan

Oil is not soluble in water.

dissolve

(verb). ăn mòn, làm tan ra

Just leave these tablets in water for a few minutes and they'll dissolve completely.

expand

(verb). mở rộng

University is a great place to start expanding your network and get to know new people.

limestone

(noun). đá vôi

You can find many interesting sculptures here made from limestone.

lava

(noun). dung nham

Flowing lava is beautiful to watch, but also really dangerous.

volcano

(noun). núi lửa

When a volcano erupts, it can bring disastrous results.

solidify

(verb). đông lại, đặc lại

Water solidifies to form ice inside the refridgerator.

beneath

(preposition). ở dưới

According to ancient folklore, there is something that lives beneath this lake.

pound

(verb). đập vào, vỗ vào

Strong waves keep pounding into the rocks.

erode

(verb). xói mòn, ăn mòn

The land here has been eroded by heavy rain.

rigid

(adjective). cứng

We used wood as flooring material because we wanted something sturdy and rigid.

formation

(noun). sự hình thành, tạo hình

This cave has some of the most beautiful formations of stalactite I have ever seen.

encounter

(verb). gặp phải

What do you do when you encounter a bear while camping?

deposit

(verb). đọng lại

Chemicals have been found to be deposited into the sea, killing coral reefs and other animals.

alternatively

(adverb). thay vào đó

If you don't drink coffee, alternatively, you can also have some tea.

flowstone

(noun). thạch nhũ có hình dạng giống như đá đang chảy xuống

The flowstone inside this cave looks incredible.

astonishing

(adjective). đáng kinh ngạc

The news was so astonishing that they couldn't believe it.

await

(verb). đang chờ đợi

They love travelling because they believe new adventures await them.

boulder

(noun). tảng đá

A big boulder sits on top of this hill.

unlock

(verb). mở ra

You need to know the right password in order to unlock this phone.

fascinate

(verb). làm kinh ngạc

He was fascinated by the stories that he read.

fraction

(noun). một phần nhỏ, phần không đáng kể

It was bigger, but only by a fraction.

intriguing

(adjective). thú vị

This forest looks intriguing and a little creepy at the same time.

hollow

(adjective). rỗng

These metal tubes are short and hollow.

temperature

(noun). nhiệt độ

The temperature is high today, so it's probably not the best idea to go out.
